title: Covering design C(35,10,3)
statement: Find 10-subsets (blocks) of {1, ..., 35} such that every 3-subset lies in some block, with as few blocks as possible. The best known size in the Covering Repository is 76 blocks (ours); a design with fewer blocks improves it.
submission: Text file: one block per line, 10 distinct points from 1..35 separated by spaces.

best_known.source: Covering Repository (coveringrepository.com), C(35,10,3) = 76 blocks: ours, listed since 2026-10-25 (before it 77); read 6 Nov 2026
